content.short: Mento issues local-currency stablecoins backed by a diversified onchain reserve.
content.description: Mento issues stablecoins denominated in several local currencies, not only dollars, backed by a diversified reserve and exchanged through an on-chain mechanism. Originating in the Celo ecosystem, it now extends to other chains including Monad. Non-dollar stablecoins matter for payments corridors where converting through dollars adds cost at both ends.
